header: What a long form asks, before it asks
subheader: The steps in order, roughly how long each takes, what to have ready.
lead: Editorial copy about a form rather than the form itself: the steps and their logic live in the TYPO3 form framework on the page the button opens.
note: Keep the step titles identical to the ones the real form shows, or this band becomes a second and wrong source of truth about the process.

steps.title: Two to eight steps
steps.text: Each row is a title, an optional duration and a sentence about what to have to hand.

steps.title: The duration is the value
steps.text: Short enough to sit under the title on one line, which is where anybody looks for it first.

steps.title: The list is ordered
steps.text: So the sequence survives being read aloud, and the numbered markers are decoration on top of it.
